_about: Public-domain Teresa of Avila (1515-1582, Carmelite reformer) in English for the Word Hoard: her Life tr. David Lewis (third edition, 1904) from CCEL, and 11 more from Internet Archive scans: John Dalton's translations of the Life (1851), the Way of Perfection, the Interior Castle (1852) and the Letters (1860); Lewis's Book of the Foundations (1871); and the Stanbrook Benedictines' Way of Perfection (1911), Interior Castle (1912), Minor Works (1913) and complete Letters (1919-1922). Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

teresa-life-lewis: The Life of St. Teresa of Jesus, Written by Herself, tr. David Lewis, third edition enlarged (London: Thomas Baker, MCMIV)

teresa-life-dalton: The Life of Saint Teresa, Written by Herself, tr. John Dalton (London: C. Dolman, MDCCCLI)
teresa-foundations-lewis: The Book of the Foundations of S. Teresa of Jesus, tr. David Lewis (London: Burns, Oates, 1871)
teresa-way-of-perfection-dalton: The Way of Perfection, and Conceptions of Divine Love, tr. John Dalton (London: C. Dolman; catalogued 1852)
teresa-way-of-perfection-stanbrook: The Way of Perfection, tr. the Benedictines of Stanbrook (London: Thomas Baker, MCMXI)
teresa-interior-castle-dalton: The Interior Castle; or, The Mansions, with some of her Letters, tr. John Dalton (London: T. Jones, 1852)
teresa-interior-castle-stanbrook: The Interior Castle or The Mansions, tr. the Benedictines of Stanbrook, second edition (New York: Benziger; imprimatur 1912)
teresa-letters-dalton: The Letters of Saint Teresa, tr. John Dalton (London: Catholic Publishing and Bookselling Co., 1860)
teresa-letters-stanbrook-1: The Letters of Saint Teresa, complete edition, vol. I, tr. the Benedictines of Stanbrook (London: Thomas Baker, MCMXIX)
teresa-letters-stanbrook-2: The Letters of Saint Teresa, vol. II, tr. the Benedictines of Stanbrook (London: Thomas Baker, MCMXXI)

teresa-minor-works: Minor Works of St. Teresa: Conceptions of the Love of God, Exclamations, Maxims and Poems, tr. the Benedictines of Stanbrook (London: Thomas Baker, MCMXIII)
